title: GBPUSD M30 London Open Delay (InpLondonOpen=11) to Bypass Opening Volatility Whipsaw
research_question: Does shifting InpLondonOpen from 8 to 11 bypass the high-loss 10:00 server hour London opening rush, turning 2026 UNSEEN net profit from -$332.75 to positive (> +$200.00) and raising win rate to >55% while preserving 5-year training viability?
hypothesis: Because forensic deal analysis of EXP-0057 and EXP-0059 revealed that 10:00 server time (the opening hour of the London session after the news filter unblocks) generated 10 losses out of 14 trades (28.6% win rate, -$604.50 loss) while all other hours maintained a 58.8% win rate (+297.00 net), shifting InpLondonOpen from 8 to 11 will filter out the 10:00 opening whipsaw. This will eliminate the primary cluster of losses, elevating 2026 UNSEEN win rate past 55% and turning net profit positive while keeping training drawdown minimal.

facts: In EXP-0059 (2026 UNSEEN), trades entering at 10:00 server time had a 28.6% win rate (4 wins vs 10 losses, -$604.50 net loss).
Trades entering outside hour 10:00 in EXP-0059 (at 11:00 and 17:00) had a combined 58.8% win rate (10 wins vs 7 losses, +$297.00 net profit).
Hours 8 and 9 are already blocked by the news filter (NEWS_HOURS = {8, 9, ...}), leaving 10:00 as the first active London entry hour under InpLondonOpen=8.
In EXP-0058 (Training), hour 11:00 produced 3 wins and 1 loss (75.0% win rate, +$201.00 net profit).
inferences: The 10:00 server hour coincides with intense early London market liquidity expansion, where premature Fibonacci retracement touches are frequently breached by false breakout spikes before true trend continuation forms.
Delaying London session entry by 1 hour (InpLondonOpen=11) allows the early London volatility rush to settle, taking only mature continuation retracements.
evidence: EXP-0059 deal analysis: Hour 10:00 total=14, wins=4, losses=10, win_rate=28.6%, net=-604.50
EXP-0059 deal analysis: Hours 11:00 & 17:00 total=17, wins=10, losses=7, win_rate=58.8%, net=+297.00
EXP-0058 deal analysis: Hour 11:00 total=4, wins=3, losses=1, win_rate=75.0%, net=+201.00

independent_variables.name: InpLondonOpen
independent_variables.rationale: Delays the London trading session window from 08:00 to 11:00 server time, bypassing the 10:00 opening volatility whipsaw.

assumptions: Hour 11:00 entries will continue to execute with positive expectancy.
Bypassing hour 10:00 will eliminate 10 losses while sacrificing only 4 wins in 2026 UNSEEN.
expected_observations: 2026 UNSEEN net profit turns positive (> +$200.00) with profit factor >= 1.30.
Equity drawdown on 2026 UNSEEN drops under 5.0%.
falsification_conditions: 2026 UNSEEN net profit remains negative (< $0.00) or win rate falls below 45%.
